source_admission: Published values and equations the study uses, with how far each was read on 2026-10-17. No outside dataset or full paper is committed; the study's other inputs are the project's committed products and the GCM's own output. 'formula checked' means the equation was transcribed from the source and verified by the tests; 'abstract' means the values were read from the abstract or a summary of it; 'secondary' means the value was read in a later paper or summary that quotes it.
